caption: Ten minutes of white-city air before the first working session. Four people, one pilot, many sticky notes.
media_alt_text: A tree-lined view along Rothschild Boulevard in central Tel Aviv.
comments: priya.shah: Demo is redacted and ready.
john.okafor: Coffee first, explainability second.

caption: Cedar asked the right question: can the dispatcher disagree and still leave a useful decision trail? That is the product.
media_alt_text: A Bauhaus facade in Tel Aviv's White City district.
comments: dana.shalev: And can we measure when the override was better?
tom.becker: Exactly our next experiment.

caption: Dune gave us a skyline and a sharper homework list: concentration, conversion, moat. Fair trade.
media_alt_text: The Tel Aviv skyline under clear light.
comments: elena.marin: Marcus already has the clean concentration chart.
noa.barak: Looking forward to round two.

caption: Day one closed with a farm-to-table debrief and exactly twelve API questions for tomorrow.
media_alt_text: An evening view of Habima Square in central Tel Aviv.
comments: john.okafor: Only twelve?
priya.shah: The other six are in the appendix.

caption: Working lunch, green plates, blue architecture diagram. Priya has reduced webhook retries to three boxes and one argument.
media_alt_text: A broad view of the Tel Aviv promenade and Mediterranean coast.
comments: priya.shah: Idempotency is not an argument, it is a promise.
tom.becker: Putting that on a slide.

caption: A tasting menu built around plants, then a pilot plan built around people. Tom chose well; Dana and Yael stayed for every course.
media_alt_text: A colorful food stall in Tel Aviv's Carmel Market.
comments: tom.becker: Smoked aubergine plus fermented chili. No notes.
dana.shalev: Except the pilot notes. Nine pages of those.

caption: Cedar: ninety days, named owners, measurable outcomes. Pending paper, but the shape is real.
media_alt_text: The restored buildings and public space around Sarona Market.
comments: amir.katz: Send the metric definitions before Friday.
john.okafor: Already assigned.

caption: One last Neve Tzedek frame before the debrief. John dashed for Dana's call while we closed three workstreams around one blue folder.
media_alt_text: A cream and rose historic building with blue shutters on a Neve Tzedek street.
comments: priya.shah: John's yellow phone with its white star is under the blue folder on our window-side green seat.
elena.marin: Car is downstairs.

caption: Vector Labs made Tel Aviv feel like one connected room. John is borrowing my camera for the operator introductions.
media_alt_text: The angular exterior of the Tel Aviv Museum of Art.
comments: michal.tal: Glad the room delivered.
priya.shah: I have the follow-up list.

caption: Pilot in principle. Sandbox promised. Data-room follow-up requested. One last look south before the airport.
media_alt_text: A view across the old hangars and water at Jaffa Port.
comments: elena.marin: Good week. Clean follow-through now.
john.okafor: First Cedar recap goes out from the airport.
